# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Toybox Hex: Tiny Terror`, a mobile-portrait browser canvas survival game based on this prompt: Killer doll horror. A satirical game inspired by Chucky with toy-sized menace, domestic chaos, dark comedy violence, possession mythology, absurd horror energy, and sneaky close-quarters attacks with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Mechanically, preserve a first-person survival evasion loop: timed depth-spawned pursuers approach the player; tapping/clicking the projected enemy hitbox removes a pursuer and increments score; a large lower thumb button plus optional device motion creates temporary retreat; close-contact enemies reduce health; zero health opens a game-over screen with final score and restart.

Presentation should be authored as satirical killer-doll domestic horror: cursed nursery, toy-box perspective, yarn scraps, crib rails, glowing possession sigils, overalls-wearing button-eyed doll, plastic knife, comic-horror splats, clear mobile HUD, and readable portrait CTAs.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first first-person survival evasion / tap-shooter canvas game
- objective: survive waves of a single approaching hostile entity by tapping projected hitboxes before close contact
- input model: tap/click canvas to attack; hold a large mobile button or shake/move device to create retreat energy
- core loop: start game, spawn pursuers by time, update depth, draw scene, tap to remove threats and score, use retreat input to buy distance, lose health on contact, restart after failure
- fail/friction state: health drops by 20 on close contact; at zero the game-over overlay appears with final score and restart CTA

## Protected Mechanics
- Spawn interval starts near 2000ms and accelerates with score while capped at a fast minimum.
- Entity projection, hitbox testing, closest-target priority, score increment, health loss, game-over, restart, and hold/shake retreat semantics are preserved.
- Mobile portrait overlay structure keeps score/health at top and the large retreat button near the lower thumb zone.

## Remix Blueprint
Killer doll horror. A satirical game inspired by Chucky with toy-sized menace, domestic chaos, dark comedy violence, possession mythology, absurd horror energy, and sneaky close-quarters attacks with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The rebuilt game is `Toybox Hex: Tiny Terror`: a possessed toy-box nursery survival game where the babysitter taps sneaky dolls as they lunge from domestic clutter, holds the door shut to push them back, and banishes as many hexes as possible before nerve collapses. Presentation, HUD vocabulary, procedural background, focal enemy silhouette, effects, fonts, and copy are transformed; the core loop is not rewritten.
